children: Nvidia stock more than erased Wednesday's gains in after-hours trading, falling 8% on a Wall Street Journal report that the board was preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang.
The stock had closed up nearly 3% in regular trading.
The shares were already falling in after-hours trading after a report by the New York Times said Huang may have had an inappropriate relationship with someone who reports to him.
This is a developing story. Please check back for further updates soon.
